name: context-evidence-budget
explain: Compute a hypothetical evidence allowance and pack already-ranked passages. Real callers must use the exact model tokenizer and recount the serialized request. This greedy fixture does not establish semantic completeness.
steps: Subtract every reserved category before selecting evidence. || Reject impossible fixed overhead and assert the packed evidence stays within its allowance.

name: eligible-neighbor-counterexample
explain: A tiny exact-distance example isolates candidate starvation after global top-k selection. It does not reproduce any particular vector engine or prove an authorization implementation.
steps: Rank the global corpus then remove unauthorized neighbors. || Rank the eligible subset and compare the recovered match.

name: upload-capacity-plan
explain: Calculate the upload part count and an illustrative worker allocation. Real resident memory includes implementation-dependent copies and native allocations; measure it under the actual process limit.
steps: Keep decimal GB separate from binary GiB and MiB. || Sum stage allocations and assert a minimum reserve before load-testing the design.
